name: Easter
date_rule: Moveable: the Sunday after the first full moon of spring
summary: The resurrection, the year's chief feast; East and West usually keep it on different Sundays.
note: Eastern observance falls on different Sundays: 5 May 2024, 20 April 2025, 12 April 2026 and 2 May 2027. In 2025 the two reckonings coincide, which they do only occasionally.
